historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission certified, 6-0, the final environmental impact report for an eight-storey, 104-foot office building of about 242,000 square feet with shops, a two-level valet garage and public open space on the lot's northwest corner (Motion 14723).
The City Planning Commission approved, 6-0, about 241,600 square feet of offices on the vacant site, then used for parking, with bulk and separation exceptions (Motions 14750 and 14751).
The City Planning Commission approved with modified conditions the Section 309 determinations of compliance and exceptions for the proposed 21-story building at 631 Folsom Street.
An earlier building on this lot: Granite Rock Company and McGowan & Butler contracted for excavating and concrete work on a three-storey brick building, at $81,073.
An earlier building on this lot: A. C. Rulofson sheet metal works contracted for iron frames and weights on a three-storey brick building.
An earlier building on this lot: a firm of builders contracted for all work on a three-storey and basement stable, at $11,233.
